reason: Even the minimum is PHP 80,000 a month locked in for a year, almost a million pesos, and if it works they will want it in every store. My store walks and what has worked before cost me nothing, so I can't sign that for a simulation from a company with no results yet.
objection: They have zero customers to show me. I'd be paying to be their guinea pig, and my IT guy is already stretched with CCTV and POS, so I doubt the 'uses your data, no new sensors' part will be as painless as they say.
would_change_my_mind: A free or very cheap pilot in 2-3 of my stores for a couple of months, no 12-month lock-in, where their recommended layout actually beats my control stores on sales.
